name: Aparthotel Bergland
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Bergland in Söll offers premier hotel-standard accommodation in Tyrol, Austria. The property features comfortable apartments of various sizes with dedicated bedrooms, living areas, and kitchens, tailored perfectly for couples and families. Guests can unwind in the on-site wellness area, which includes a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation room. In summer, an outdoor sunbathing lawn complete with a swimming pool invites you to bask in the alpine sunshine. A delicious breakfast is served daily in the hotel restaurant. Thanks to its prime location in the Sölllandl valley, hiking networks and world-class ski areas are easily within reach.
